C0536.title: Man Fakes Moldy Fruit Photos for Bulk 'Refund-Only' Claims, Then Resells Goods, Sentenced to One Year
C0536.summary: Tan Mouwen purchased durians and cherries on Taobao and Douyin, fabricated spoilage images to file batch refund-only requests, then resold the intact fruit for profit. Over three to four months, he carried out more than 100 fraudulent transactions, illegally obtaining fruit worth over 16,000 yuan, and was sentenced to one year in prison.

references.title: Man fakes moldy fruit photos after online purchase, batch applies for 'refund-only' then resells, sentenced to 1 year
